text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Commerce minister urged Bahrain's family-dominated businesses to open up and usher in a new era of private investment.
- France and other arms suppliers have invested more than $250 million into 14 projects in the United Arab Emirates over the last few years as part if their offset commitments, a UAE official said.
- Bahrain adjourns trial of alleged Qatari spies until December 14.
- Premier says banks and company profits point to a good economic performance in 1996.
- Egypt Airways recieved its first Airbus plane this week.
